tool_signatures.name: openfda_dataframe_describe
tool_signatures.description: List the tables and column schemas on a DataCanvas staged by an openFDA search tool. Call before openfda_dataframe_query to discover the exact table name, column names, and DuckDB types needed for valid SQL. row_count is the full staged result set, not the inline preview count. Columns typed JSON hold nested openFDA objects/arrays — query them with DuckDB json functions.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID from an openFDA search tool response.

kind.description: Object type: "table" for staged data, "view" for a derived view.

name.description: Table or view name — use verbatim in SQL FROM clauses.
Column name — use in SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY.

type.description: DuckDB type (VARCHAR, JSON, BIGINT, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN, ...).

nullable.description: True when the column may contain NULL. Absent when unknown.

items.description: A single column in the table.

columns.description: All columns in this table, in schema order.

row_count.description: Total rows in this table — the full staged set, not the inline preview.

items.description: A registered table or view on the canvas.

tables.description: All tables and views available on this canvas.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID that was described — pass to openfda_dataframe_query.

tool_signatures.name: openfda_dataframe_query
tool_signatures.description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT against a DataCanvas table staged by an openFDA search tool (canvas_id + canvas_table in its response when spilled=true). Enables GROUP BY, COUNT/SUM/AVG, time-series, and joins across the full result set without re-paging the API. Call openfda_dataframe_describe first to get the exact table and column names. Scalar fields are stored as text (CAST for numeric math); nested objects/arrays are JSON columns — read them with DuckDB json functions, e.g. json_extract_string(openfda, '$.brand_name[0]'). Only SELECT is allowed — DDL, DML, COPY, and file-reading functions are blocked.

query.description: SQL SELECT against the staged table. Use the table name from openfda_dataframe_describe. Example: "SELECT classification, COUNT(*) AS n FROM spilled_ab12cd34 GROUP BY classification ORDER BY n DESC".

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID from an openFDA search tool response (the canvas_id field).

items.description: A result row — keys are the SELECT column names, values the computed data.

rows.description: Rows returned by the query (capped at the canvas row limit).

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID that was queried — reuse for follow-up queries.

row_count.description: Number of rows in this response.

endpoint.description: openFDA endpoint to describe (e.g. "drug/event", "drug/shortages", "device/510k"). Must be one of the cataloged endpoints.

path.description: Dotted field path for use in search queries

type.description: Data type (string, date, integer, float, boolean)

items.description: A named group of related fields

endpoint.description: The endpoint these fields apply to

queryTips.description: openFDA query syntax reminders relevant to this endpoint

tool_signatures.name: openfda_drug_profile
tool_signatures.description: Resolve one drug name to its FDA identity, then fan out in parallel across the bounded per-drug openFDA endpoints and merge into one profile: identity, label highlights, adverse-event summary, recall history, Drugs@FDA approval, and shortage status. Replaces chaining openfda_get_drug_label, openfda_search_adverse_events, openfda_search_recalls, openfda_search_drug_approvals, and openfda_search_drug_shortages — and reconciles the identifier drift between endpoints that makes that chaining error-prone. Each section is best-effort: a miss returns null rather than failing the call. For deep dives into any one area, use the dedicated tool.

drug.description: Drug name to profile — brand or generic (e.g. "metformin", "Humira", "Glucophage"). Resolved once to canonical FDA identifiers, which then key every sub-query.
The drug name supplied in the request, echoed back.

fanOutKey.description: Canonical key the structured sub-queries (recall/enforcement, Drugs@FDA approval, shortage) ran against — the resolved generic name, falling back to a brand name, then the input term. The adverse-event sub-query instead keys off the raw input term to match heterogeneous reporter-entered values.

resolvedVia.description: Which endpoint resolved the canonical identity: drug/label, drug/ndc, or none.

warnings.description: Warnings (truncated) — boxed warning or warnings_and_cautions for Rx labels, falling back to the OTC-monograph warnings section.

label.description: Label highlights from drug/label, or null when no label matched.

notice.description: Guidance when the drug could not be resolved or upstream errors degraded the profile. Absent on a fully populated profile.

items.description: A single recall or enforcement action.

recalls.description: Recent drug/enforcement recall actions (may be empty).

approval.description: Drugs@FDA approval summary, or null when no application matched.

rxcui.description: RxNorm concept unique identifier, when available.

spl_set_id.description: SPL set ID for the drug label, when available.

generic_name.description: Canonical generic name (openfda.generic_name) — the primary source for meta.fanOutKey.

identity.description: Identity resolved once and reused across every sub-query to avoid identifier drift.

shortage.description: Current or most-recent drug shortage status, or null when none on record.

sectionsFound.description: How many profile sections (label, adverse_events, recalls, approval, shortage) returned data.

total.description: Approximate total adverse-event reports naming this drug.

items.description: A reaction term paired with its report count.

adverse_events.description: Adverse-event summary aggregated over drug/event, or null when unavailable.
